messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — saw a tenant-triggered rollback today where v2 pinned, then fallback bounced between tied variants. noisy telemetry spike and quota blips. anyone else see this?
Chris: saw that in traces, looks like the fallback ordering for tied variants is non-deterministic under soft-fail. leads to churn across backends.
Olga: yeah, fallback tie-break uses round-robin across compatible variants which is fine normally, but when quota smoothing kicks in we get oscillation.
Sam: can we sample the requests and show the last-10 fallback targets in the console? would make debugging much faster.
Maya: +1 to console telemetry. Lina — could we add a small UX affordance that surfaces "rollback risk" when variants are tied? maybe a red flag when sampling entropy > 0.6
Lina: we can add a tiny banner: "variants tied — fallback may split traffic across X nodes". but need to avoid alarming customers. think we should show a score and a tooltip.
Chris: operationally we should also introduce a soft-rollback mode: instead of immediate switch, apply a smoothing window (t=30s) and prefer the last-successful variant unless overloaded. Pseudocode: 
```
if tie && recent_failures > thresh:
  prefer sticky_last_successful()
  apply exponential_backoff_switch()
```
Olga: that helps. Also suggest incrementally draining by route so tenant quota doesn't spike on other variants. We should fold that into quota-smoothing config.
Maya: concrete ask: eng-platform to prototype sticky_last_successful and telemetry hooks; product/console to show a 3-state indicator (green/amber/red) and list sampled fallback targets.
Sam: for telemetry hooks — query suggestion: 
`SELECT variant, count(*) FROM requests WHERE tenant_id = ? AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY variant ORDER BY ts desc LIMIT 50;`
Use that to show last 50 fallback targets and a little sparkline for churn.
Lina: UX note — keep it collapsed by default; only expand when churn > 3 switches/min to avoid noise.
Olga: question about quotas — if we sticky to last_successful, we risk overloading it while others are idle. propose adding a circuit-breaker metric: if SLA latency > p95 threshold for 10s, break sticky and disperse.
Chris: agreed. state machine: NORMAL -> SOFT_ROLLBACK (sticky) -> CIRCUIT_BREAK -> DISTRIBUTE. Want telemetry to emit the current state with reasons so the console can link to traces.
Maya: can we add an event `route.rollback.soft` with tags: tenant, route, from_variant, to_variant, reason=quota|latency|error, sampling=true?
deploy-bot: started canary deploy run: rollout/soft-rollback-probe v2 -> v1 (canary) at 1745600120
Sam: nice, deploy-bot — include a flag to sample fallback_history in the canary run.
Lina: timeline: eng-platform PR for sticky/circuit-breaker by EOD Thurs, console mock by next Tue. We'll prototype telemetry event shape and run a 24h shadow.
Olga: one more ask — add an opt-in tenant header `X-Compat-Rollback=soft` so customers can test behavior before we flip default. document in console under route advanced settings.
Maya: love that. I'll file a tiny doc and link in-channel. thanks all :thumbsup:
Chris: logging note — please include `fallback_reason` and `stick_attempts` fields in JSON logs so our evals can measure efficacy.
Sam: I'll add a dashboard tile: fallback-switch-rate, average stick-duration, affected-tenants. keep it 1m granularity.
Lina: UX will hide tile unless user has tenant admin perms.
Maya: ok closing loop — eng-platform owners @Olga @Chris please sync on strategy and drop the PR link here when ready. I'll create a follow-up thread for console copy.
Olga: will do, starting design doc now.
notes: prototype plan: sticky last-successful + circuit-breaker + console telemetry; opt-in header; canary run started
